title: Crispy Baked Chicken Tacos
ingredients: Chicken Marinade: 1 lb chicken, cut into small cubes
½ cup bell pepper mix (red, yellow, green), chopped
½ cup grated mozzarella and cheddar cheese mix
Additional cheddar and mozzarella cheese for topping
instructions: Step 1: Marinate the chicken — in a bowl, combine cubed chicken with ginger garlic paste, oil, and seasonings. Ensure it's well coated. Let marinate at least 30 minutes, up to a few hours for better flavor.
Step 2: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat. Add marinated chicken and sauté until cooked through.
Step 3: Add chopped white onion and bell pepper mix; sauté until vegetables are tender.
Step 4: Stir in mozzarella and cheddar cheese mix and cream cheese. Mix until melted and combined.
Step 6: Make the taco sauce by grinding mayo, sour cream, cilantro/parsley, chili sauce, lemon juice, garlic cloves, salt and pepper into a paste.
Step 7: Assemble tacos — brush one side of each tortilla with oil. Add chicken filling to the unoiled side. Top with additional cheddar and mozzarella cheese.
Step 8: Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until tortillas are golden brown and cheese is melted and bubbly.
Step 9: Serve with the prepared sauce.
notes: Recipe from Amna Ahmed via Facebook reel caption.
